VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently inspected candidate e38b0f9eb06c9bd4bb029ff75deab9f97d083960 (HEAD matched) and the full base-to-candidate diff: AC-4 NOT SATISFIED overall, required product value satisfied at src/math.mjs:73 and test/math.test.mjs:86, validation/R-1 satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-71, no-mutation/R-2 NOT SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:72; R-3 satisfied by unchanged existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-66 and unchanged existing tests at test/math.test.mjs:5-83 with only permitted import edit at line 3; R-4 satisfied by unchanged package.json:1-10 and no dependency/generated-file changes; R-5 satisfied by product-prefixed test at test/math.test.mjs:85.
Findings: MEDIUM at src/math.mjs:72 — values.sort mutates caller input, violating AC-4/R-2 and changing observable caller state, with [4,2,3] becoming [2,3,4]; smallest verification is assert product([4,2,3]) returns 24 while the original array remains deeply equal to its saved copy; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-87 — the sole product test covers only an already-sorted happy path and omits the required empty-array RangeError, invalid-shape/invalid-element TypeError, and no-mutation behavior, allowing contract regressions and the present mutation defect to pass; smallest verification is add product-prefixed tests for these error classes and unchanged unsorted input, then rerun the focused suite.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "product of several values", "tests 1", "pass 1", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 16", "pass 15", "fail 1", solely "clamp respects upper bound" (expected and unchanged, not a finding); read-only node -e mutation probe exited 1 with "product result: 24; input after call: [2,3,4]" and "AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: product must not mutate input"; read-only node -e validation probe exited 0 with "PASS: empty array RangeError, 5 invalid shapes TypeError, 7 invalid-element arrays TypeError"; git diff --check exited 0 without output; initial here-document probes were blocked by sandbox temporary-file restrictions and were rerun through node -e without files; no required checks unavailable, no remaining material uncertainty, no files changed, and mutation repair plus missing regression coverage remain for the implementer.
